subject: general
question: As per Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) data for the year 2020, which country has highest per capita total spending on health?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**USA.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The USA is the highest per capita total spending on health worldwide. 
 
• The total health expenditure in the U.S. exceeded four trillion dollars.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)**

 
 
• It is an intergovernmental economic organization with 38 member countries, founded in 1961 to stimulate economic progress and world trade.
 
• India is not a member of OECD but has been a **key economic partner.**
 
• OECD Headquarters: Paris, France
 
• OECD Founded: 30 September 1961
